title: What to Do When AI's First Draft Misses

items.label: Redirect what is close
items.body: Keep the structure and tone, then name the exact fix. Correction beats a blanket rewrite.

items.label: Narrow the frame
items.body: When the output reads generic, name the exact audience and the situation it must speak to.

items.label: Set the contrast
items.body: Say what you do not want as precisely as what you do, so it stops defaulting to the safe voice.

items.label: Ask for the thinking first
items.body: On complex work, request the key tensions and trade-offs before the draft, then build from there.
